test_search_isolation: test that MemoryThreadMetaStore search returns only threads owned by the current user
test_get_isolation: test that MemoryThreadMetaStore get returns None for threads owned by another user
test_update_display_name_denied: test that a user cannot rename another user's thread display name
test_update_status_denied: test that a user cannot change the status of another user's thread
test_delete_denied: test that a user cannot delete another user's thread
